fields.sample_size: documentary analysis of public-policy instruments and coordination attempts for water and sanitation in Buenos Aires province, 1973-2012 (narrative approach); no respondent sample
fields.effect_estimate: Water and sanitation services in the province consolidated into three coexisting provision subsystems (e.g. provincial and national utilities, municipal and cooperative providers), with a multiplicity of actors, weak coordination attempts and territorial inequality in access as structural features since the 1973 institutionalisation. Narrative qualitative analysis; no effect estimates.
fields.study_design: qualitative narrative policy-history analysis (instruments and coordination attempts)
fields.section: Full text: Methodology (narrative approach); institutionalisation and trajectory 1973-2012; three subsystems; Conclusions
fields.exact_location: Methodology (narrative approach); institutionalisation and trajectory 1973-2012; three subsystems; Conclusions

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a narrative analysis of the institutional trajectory of water and sanitation policy in Buenos Aires province 1973-2012, read in full text 2026-10-04. Three coexisting provision subsystems, many actors, failed coordination and unequal territorial access. Qualitative, no outcome estimates.
notes: Abstract-level extraction accurate; adds that the subsystems are of coexisting providers. Policy-history study; direct evidence on fragmented institutional arrangements.
